pass.A_citation: Each of the 20 in-document runs finishes answered, its kb_search tool.completed.retrieved holds the expected entry's hash, and its answer text names the expected path. Threshold 20 of 20.
pass.B_gap: Each out-of-document question shares no bm25 token with the three documents (precondition). As a run, its kb_search retrieves no entry. As coverage questions in a second definition, all 4 are gaps, no compiler request mentions them, and publish is refused naming exactly those 4 while the published head does not move. Threshold 4 of 4 on every part.
pass.C_restricted: A compile of the D3 roster aimed at the hosted endpoint fails as refused by egress, and the roster-id message to an agent on the hosted endpoint finishes refused. The hosted fake's request counter does not move for either. A D1 control message to the same agent moves it by exactly 1, so the counter is live. Over the whole script the hosted fake sees exactly 1 request.
pass.D_record: Every run started in the script has run.started, run.finished and verifyChain(events) === null, and run.started.agent is a 64-hex hash present in agent_versions. Every run of the same agent and published snapshot carries the same hash. Threshold: every run.
